paragraphs: Rabbi Chizkiyah, student of R. Yirmeyah. In Zevachim 75b: Rav Huna and R. Chizkiyah, students of R. Yirmeyah. “R. Yirmeyah said in the name of R. Shimon ben Yochai”: Sukkah 45b, several statements; and in Chelek 97b. “R. Yirmeyah said”: Jerusalem Shekalim, chapter 1, halakhah 11; Jerusalem Berakhot, chapter 5, end of mishnah 2, several statements; and in HaRoeh, mishnah 2, several statements.
